info.name: ROS Policy
info.description:
HTTP collection for the ROS Policy FastAPI backend (`/api/v1`).

**Setup**
1. Import this collection and the companion environment `DRPE.local.postman_environment.json`.
2. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:8000`) and `apiKey` (your `DRPE_API_KEY`; leave empty if auth is off).
3. Optionally set `policyId`, `jobId`, `requestId`, `webhookId` after creating resources.

Auth: Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}`).
OpenAPI source: `openapi/openapi.json`.

**Catalog & holds**
- `Systems` / `Processes` — governance catalog + policy link replace-sets
- Policy folder includes List/Set Policy Systems and Processes
- `Grace Holds` — list/get/force/cancel enforcement holds
- Set env vars `systemId`, `processId`, `holdId` after creating resources

item.name: Policies
item.description: Validate, import, CRUD, versions, diff, and activate.

body.raw:
{
  "yaml": "policy:
  id: pol_postman_demo
  name: Postman Demo Policy
  status: draft
  jurisdiction: EU_GDPR
  data_classification: PII
  scope:
    data_types: [customer_profile]
  rules:
    - id: rule_inactive_delete
      priority: 100
      condition:
        all:
          - field: status
            operator: eq
            value: inactive
          - field: last_activity_at
            operator: older_than
            value: 730d
      action: delete
      grace_period: 30d
"
}
